about_the_game:
A Tribute to the Iconic "NieR" Sound That Took the Gaming World by Storm!

This tribute album brings together artists from diverse genres to reimagine the legendary soundtracks in their own unique styles.

The lineup features a total of 12 groups, including renowned artists such as world's end girlfriend, sasakure.UK, and Schroeder-Headz, as well as Nobuyoshi Sano and Takayuki Aihara, the composers behind Square Enix's action RPG Drakengard.

With each artist delivering their own distinct interpretation, this album offers a fresh new take on the beloved NieR sound—an absolute must-listen for fans!

For the best experience, we highly recommend playing the album from start to finish in order.
